summary: Hardcoded RSA private key for author's SSH server shipped in package
details: cli.js embeds a base64-encoded RSA private key in CONFIG.encodedSSHKey. On invocation the key is decoded via Buffer.from(..., 'base64'), written to a temp file with mode 0o600, and used with `ssh -i <keyfile> ubuntu@79.72.65.161` to run the tool's signup/login/build commands against the author's build server. The key authorizes access to the author-operated host (ubuntu@79.72.65.161); it is not used to route installer data to an attacker destination and no code in the package reads installer-side secrets or fetches remote code at install/import time. Anyone with the package can authenticate to the author's server as user 'ubuntu', which is a credential exposure affecting the author's infrastructure, not the machine that installed the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
